entries.summary: The PKCS#11 feature in ssh-agent allows remote code execution when a forwarded agent is reachable.
sshd does not correctly initialise supplementary groups for some AuthorizedKeysCommand or AuthorizedPrincipalsCommand configurations, allowing privilege escalation.
A one-byte heap overwrite in the DNS resolver can lead to worker process crash or remote code execution.
Error page handling in the ngx_http_core_module allows request smuggling under specific configurations.
Ghostcat: the AJP connector exposes file contents and application classes to unauthenticated requests.
Spring4Shell: data binding on a Java 9+ Tomcat deployment allows remote code execution.
Path traversal in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 can expose files outside the document root.
